notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – Version 0.1.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Update 0.1.5 is here, bringing some long-awaited improvements to visuals and usability. Here's what's new:

📄 "New Document" Indicator Added

    Newly discovered documents are now marked as “new” by highlighting their category in red within the notes menu. This helps you quickly find what you haven’t read yet.

💡 Lighting Bug Fixes

    Several known lighting issues have been addressed, improving overall visual consistency and removing unintended brightness or flickering in certain areas.

🌑 Improved Shadow Rendering

    Shadows have been redesigned to appear softer and more natural, replacing the old flat black textures with more realistic depth and form.

Thanks for all your continued feedback — each patch gets us closer to delivering the full horror experience we envision for Occultus Vitae.

– Place2Start Studio 💀

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – Version 0.1.4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Here’s what’s new in the latest update 0.1.4 for Occultus Vitae! This patch focuses on gameplay progression, atmosphere, and bug fixing.

🌗 Global Lighting Adjustments (Again!)

We’ve further fine-tuned global lighting settings to enhance the overall visual balance and mood of the environment.

🧩 First Puzzle Implemented

A new puzzle has been added! It’s now required to uncover more story elements and progress to the end of the level. Pay attention to your surroundings!

🎥 Autofocus Feature Added

We've added an autofocus system that automatically adjusts the camera to the object you're observing. This provides smoother transitions and improves immersion during interactions.

🎵 Background Music for Atmosphere

New ambient background music has been implemented to support the overall atmosphere and intensify the creepy, immersive vibe of the game.

🪨 Environment Fixes

Fixed a bug that caused floating stones in the environment.

Resolved an issue in one building where part of the floor was slightly invisible, causing visual inconsistencies.

As always, thank you for testing, exploring, and helping shape Occultus Vitae. More updates coming soon!

– Place2Start Studio 💀

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – Version 0.1.3.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Here’s what’s new in the latest update 0.1.3.2 for Occultus Vitae! This patch focuses on gameplay progression, immersion, and further lighting refinements.

🌗 Global Lighting Adjustments (Again!)

    We’ve once again fine-tuned the global lighting settings to improve the overall mood and visibility across the environment. Expect a more atmospheric and balanced visual experience.

🧩 First Puzzle Implemented

    A new puzzle has been added! It’s now required to uncover additional story elements and to complete the level. Explore carefully and connect the clues to progress.

🎥 Autofocus Feature Added

    We’ve introduced an autofocus system that adjusts the in-game camera to focus on the object or area you’re looking at. This creates smoother transitions and enhances immersion during interactions and exploration.

More updates and content are on the way. Thanks again for testing, exploring, and helping us shape Occultus Vitae!

– Place2Start Studio 💀

notes.title: 🛠️ Hotfix 0.1.2 – Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Hotfix 0.1.2 is now live! We've made a few important adjustments to improve your experience with Occultus Vitae. Here's what's changed:

🌕 Global Lighting Adjustment

    We’ve fine-tuned the overall lighting to improve visibility and atmosphere throughout the level. Shadows and brightness should now feel more balanced.

🛠️ Debug Key “L” Removed

    The temporary debug feature that caused the player to lose 20% health when pressing L has been removed from the live build.

🎧 Audio Bug Fix – Intro

    Fixed an issue where the intro phone call audio was overlapping or mixing with unintended sounds. It should now play cleanly as intended.

Thanks again for all your feedback and support. More updates and content are coming soon!

– Place2Start Studio 💀

notes.title: Patch Notes - Hotfix Version 0.1.1
notes.notes:
🔧 Fixes & Improvements:

    Game Icon: The game icon now displays correctly on Windows devices.

    Audio Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where the doctor’s phone call audio only played on one headphone channel. The dialogue now plays properly on both sides.

    Forest Cabin Fix: Removed the door and ghost event at the forest cabin due to upcoming rework. These elements will be reintroduced in a future update.

    "High Castle" Landmark: Added an off-map visual of the High Castle in the background to help guide players towards the correct path.

    Stability & Performance Fixes:
        Optimized environment loading to reduce stuttering.
        Minor memory optimizations for smoother gameplay.
        Fixed rare crashes related to AI pathfinding.

More updates and improvements are on the way – thank you for your support! 🚀💀
